integrity: The exact criterion is proved analytically from integer-support variance bounds and an exchangeable moment-matching construction. Finite exact-rational computation is used only to replay the formulas and threshold over a broad parameter range.
scientific_limitations: The complete-threshold theorem is for unbiased Bernoulli marginals and pairwise independence.
The result does not classify minimum sample-space size or extend the sharp threshold to higher-wise independence.
The originality search was targeted; an equivalent congruence-support theorem could be hidden in coding-theoretic literature.
title: Exact threshold for modular freedom under pairwise-independent fair bits
